gate.rule: confirmed invalid candidate geometry scores 0 with status candidate_invalid; reference measurement failures, unsupported metrics, and evaluator failures block aggregation with a null score and are reported separately from geometry validity

notes: shape=global geometry (IoU+SurfaceF1+Topology mean, official CADGenBench APIs); dimension=annotation-driven key-dimension pass rate; distance=tail-deviation (symmetric p99 vs 10x official 0.005*diagonal threshold scale); mass=pose-invariant volume/principal-inertia errors; face_match=per-type face-level F1 with geometric gates; section=annotated cross-section contour/area/perimeter comparison. Weights are an explicit proposal for review, not calibrated constants; aggregation script reads this file so they can be changed without touching any scorer. Rank eligibility remains false.
